values: 1. Run PortalFrame and download both the Prokon A03 and audit JSON from the completed analysis.
2. Open the A03 in Prokon, replot the structure, and confirm axes, releases, supports and load arrows before analysing.
3. Export Prokon reactions, end forces and displacements for the same named ULS/SLS combinations.
4. Compare characteristic cases first, then combinations. Do not compare unrelated factored reactions.
5. Prokon bracing and haunch boundaries are node-based; every exported restraint/haunch station is therefore an explicit node.
6. This workbook is a readable review of the JSON. Editing it does not alter the generated A03.
Warning: The Prokon model is an analysis comparison input, not an independent design verification.
Warning: PortalFrame local Fy/Fz member loads are exported as Prokon local L loads; confirm the plotted arrow direction before analysis.
Warning: Spring stiffness is exported from the value actually applied to the PortalFrame FE model after unit conversion.
